node: Civil Reserve Manufacturing Network and surge-capacity qualification layer
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the Civil Reserve Manufacturing Network qualification layer found a small set of US-listed or US-traded companies plausibly exposed to defense surge-capacity qualification, secure manufacturing, additive manufacturing, CMMC/ITAR/AS9100 compliance, and supplier-network auditability. The strongest underfollowed angle is not weapons production itself, but the infrastructure required to pre-qualify civilian or dual-use factories: certified additive capacity, vetted distributed manufacturing networks, cyber/compliance software, and traceable production workflows. No candidate is upgraded beyond Layer 1B because the CRMN funding path remains authorization-dependent and evidence of direct CRMN awards is not yet established in the provided evidence.
